scripts.android:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync android
scripts.android:debug: npm run android:sync && cd android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$env:JAVA_HOME='C:\Program Files\Android\Android Studio\jbr'; .\gradlew.bat assembleDebug"
scripts.ios:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync ios
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: npm run build && npx cap sync android && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/run-android-device.ps1
